correctness.rationale: Weyl conjugation acts by distinct characters on the Weyl matrix basis, so Fourier projection of the projector orbit isolates exactly the nonzero Weyl coefficients of gg*. The nondegenerate trace pairing gives the same rank for the complex analysis map. At b=0 use positivity on each nonempty overlap. At order p^j, reduction modulo X^(p^j)-1 folds the rational coefficients, and divisibility by the minimal polynomial 1+X^(p^(j-1))+...+X^((p-1)p^(j-1)) forces the p coefficients over each lowest j-1 digits to agree; the quotient has degree less than p^(j-1). All primitive frequencies of that order are conjugate. For the taper the exponent x+((x-a) mod n) reduces to 2x-a modulo n, hence is injective for odd n; disjoint collections of binary powers cannot have the same nonzero sum. This saturates the upper bound n|S-S| without any numerical tolerance. For the flat cross the long axis covers all nonzero multiples of p, giving rank p there. At ±1 the p overlap points represent all classes modulo p once and occupy no complete size-p fiber modulo p^2. At zero the residue 0 class has weight p rather than 1 and the nonzero classes have singleton fibers, so neither order vanishes. Other short-axis shifts of magnitude r between 2 and p-1 have p-r short-axis pairs plus one additional pair, and remaining shifts have at most two cross-axis pairs and no same-axis pairs. Every such overlap is nonempty by the difference-cover representation r-tp and has size less than p, so equal fibers are impossible at either nonzero order. Summing gives the frozen rank and |S|(|S|-1)≥p²-1 forces |S|≥p+1.
residual_risks: Reduction into F_109 gives a lower bound on complex matrix rank, not an automatic equality; the exact characteristic-zero rank here follows from the layer calculation. No conditioning bound is claimed.

checked_sources: Frozen RESULT.md Finding, proof and limitations
value.rationale: The result turns evaluating many cyclotomic-weighted measurements into exact rational equality tests and gives a concrete warning about sparsity: a support meeting the difference-cover criterion can have a large flat-window deficiency even though an explicit positive reweighting gives informational completeness on that very support. The shiftwise census identifies the lost modes and the taper eliminates probabilistic or generic existence in all supported shifts. This is useful for exact rank and support design despite the lack of stability guarantees.
residual_risks: The exponential dynamic range limits numerical use; no optimal-support, noise-stability or reduced-measurement result follows.
